NEW SECTION . 8A.311C State purchasing 4 contracts —— prohibited terms. 5 The provisions set forth in this section are void as a matter 6 of law as contrary to public policy if included in a contract 7 for the procurement of goods or services entered into by the 8 department or any other state agency pursuant to this part. 9 A state agency’s contract that includes any of the following 10 provisions shall be interpreted as if the contract did not 11 include the void provision: 12 1. A provision that requires the state or its agencies to 13 defend, indemnify, hold harmless another person, or otherwise 14 assume the debt or liability of another person in violation of 15 Article VII, section 1, of the Constitution of the State of 16 Iowa. 17 2. A provision that seeks to impose vendor terms that 18 are unknown at the time of signing the contract or can be 19 unilaterally changed by the vendor. 20 3. A provision that violates chapter 13 by not allowing 21 a state agency to participate in its own defense through 22 representation by the attorney general. 23 4. A provision that grants to any person other than the 24 attorney general the authority to convey to a court or litigant 25 the state’s consent to any settlement of a suit involving the 26 contract when such settlement could impose liability on the 27 state. 28 5. A provision that specifies that the contract is governed 29 by the laws of a foreign state or nation. 30 6. A provision that claims blanket confidentiality of the 31 contract’s terms. 32 7. NEW SECTION . 8A.311D State purchasing contracts —— 5 required terms. 6 All of the following provisions shall be deemed to be 7 included in a state agency vendor contract: 8 1. Governing law. The contract shall be governed by 9 the laws of the state of Iowa, without giving effect to any 10 conflict of laws principles of Iowa law that may require the 11 application of another jurisdiction’s law. 12 2. Venue. Any litigation commenced in connection with the 13 contract shall be brought and maintained in an appropriate 14 state or federal court sitting in Iowa. 15 Sec. 3. NEW SECTION . 8A.311E State purchasing contracts —— 16 waiver. 17 If the director determines that a necessary good or service 18 is impossible to procure due to a requirement of section 19 8A.311C or 8A.311D, the director may waive the requirement 20 to the extent necessary to obtain the good or service. A 21 state agency requesting a waiver shall, at a minimum, provide 22 sufficient evidence showing that the state will suffer an 23 interruption in business operations or other irreparable harm 24 if the state agency cannot procure the good or service, and 25 that the state agency has exhausted all reasonable steps to 26 prevent such harm, including attempting to procure substitute 27 goods or services. The director may require the submission of 28 additional evidence at the director’s discretion. A waiver 29 must be as narrow as possible to allow the procurement of the 30 necessary good or service. 31 Sec. 4. APPLICABILITY. This Act applies to contracts 32 entered into or renewed on or after the effective date of this 33 Act. > 34 2.
